limitations: Capture is a wall-clock sample, not an instruction/frame-boundary checkpoint; the matching BMP may show the last completed front page while DS describes work on the back page.
Mesh header origin words, xvec, omat, tmat, rdf, ysign and current pointers are transient scratch for the most recently processed object, not persistent transforms of every object.
Palette colors[] is the base palette. Actual VGA DAC state is not captured directly; matching BMP RGB values are the rendered display evidence.
